title: confiture migrate fix-signatures --format json
description: Stale function overloads (and, with --check-body, drifted bodies) and their fix; `status` names the shape. `clean`: nothing to fix. `unfixable`: drift remains but no stale overload or drifted body has a source definition (exit 1). `dry_run` (--mode plan, the default): the SQL a fix would run. `applied` / `partial` (--mode apply): the fixes committed in one transaction and what a re-check still finds (`partial`, exit 1). The --check-body keys appear only with --check-body. A missing config, a schema auto-build that fails, an unreachable database, or a fix PostgreSQL refuses (the transaction rolled back, SQL_001) writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json) instead.

oneOf.description: No stale overload, and with --check-body no drifted body.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.
